channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: New technology improves understanding of eye pressure and glaucoma
item.description: For many at risk of glaucoma, healthy eye pressure is key to preserving vision. Despite decades of research, challenges remain.

item.title: How blood vessels differentiate growth from inflammation
item.description: The angiopoietin-Tie signaling pathway is crucial for healthy blood vessel maturation and maintenance, providing stability.

item.title: Plant-based grocery support linked to lower blood pressure and weight in 68 adults
item.description: Providing nutritious foods can help manage chronic metabolic diseases like type 2 diabetes and hypertension, though most programs face limitations.

item.title: Weekly cisplatin shows no reduction in serious side effects for p16-negative head and neck cancer
item.description: Physicians often use higher-dose cisplatin every three weeks or lower-dose weekly with radiation to treat head and neck cancer.
